heading: Membership
lead: An individual is eligible for membership in the corporation only if the individual—

tree.text: has served in the Armed Forces of—

children.text: the United States at any time during—
the period from April 6, 1917, through November 11, 1918; or
a government associated with the United States during a period or time referred to in subclause (A) of this clause and was a citizen of the United States when the individual entered that service; and

tree.text: was honorably discharged or separated from that service or continues to serve honorably during or after that period or time.

notes.text: This amends section 21703(1)(A)(iv) of title 36 to reflect changes made by Public Law 105–110 (Nov. 20, 1997, 111 Stat. 2270).

notes.heading: Findings and Sense of Congress
notes.text: Pub.
